standard.title: Processing and Representing Data
standard.description: sort and order data and information and represent patterns, including with provided tables and visual or physical models
standard.prior_knowledge: Students can sort objects by observable features (F band). They now extend to sorting and ordering scientific data and identifying patterns in provided formats.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students sort and order data using provided tables, graphic organisers and visual models, and identify simple patterns in sorted data.

nodes.label: Data is sorted and ordered to show patterns
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can sort and order data into provided categories, use a provided table or graphic organiser to organise their data, and identify one pattern from the organised data.
nodes.minimum_width: Students sort data into two categories using a provided organiser and identify one pattern from the sorted data.
nodes.typical_width: Students use pictographs, tables and graphic organisers to sort data (plants vs animals, push vs pull objects, seasonal changes across the year); order data (sequential images of plant growth, seasonal changes); and identify patterns in organised data.
wider: Use pictographs with drawings or digital photographs to document patterns of plant growth
Order images of seasonal changes across the year — examining time-ordered pattern representation
Use graphic organisers to sort objects that need a push vs pull force to work
success_criteria: Sorts data into at least two categories using a provided organiser
Identifies one pattern from the organised or ordered data
